suppress.notes: Apache Kafka marks CVE-2026-41115 as a documentation/ACL guidance issue. Their advisory lists affected versions 4.0.0 - 4.3.0 and fixed versions 4.0.0 - 4.3.0, so there is no patched kafka-clients release to upgrade to for this specific finding.

opentelemetry-semconv is a semantic-conventions artifact and the latest Maven Central release is still 1.41.1. Dependency-Check maps it to the generic OpenTelemetry CPE and reports CVEs that are not remediable via a semconv artifact upgrade at this time.
opentelemetry-proto is generated OTLP protobuf classes. The latest Maven Central release is still 1.10.0-alpha, so there is no newer artifact to consume for these findings.
